title: ATEEZ Unveils 'Drip' MV Ahead of Mini Album 15
text:
ATEEZ Unveils 'Drip' MV Ahead of Mini Album 15 
 ATEEZ Unveils 'Drip' MV Ahead of Mini Album 15
 News - 23 Oct 2026 
 By PAP Magazine Editorial
 TL;DR 
 ATEEZ has unveiled the music video for 'Drip', a pre-release single from their 15th mini album. Built on heavy, hard-hitting trap rhythms, the track lays bare the group's bold attitude and unapologetic swagger.
 ◎ 
 See the original post on Instagram 
 ↗ 
 ATEEZ has unveiled the music video for 'Drip', a pre-release single from their 15th mini album. Built on heavy, hard-hitting trap rhythms, the track lays bare the group's bold attitude and unapologetic swagger. Following 'BAD', this is another chance to witness the performance powerhouses in their element. Addictive hooks pull you in deeper with every listen. Confident beats cement their unmistakable sonic identity.
Trap is a hip-hop subgenre defined by 808 bass and rapid hi-hats. 'Drip' retains the genre's weighty texture while injecting ATEEZ's signature energy. Though a pre-release, it boasts title-track-level polish. It's a strategic move that raises anticipation for the full mini album to come.
The music video translates the song's intensity into visual form. Dark lighting and dynamic camera movements build tension throughout. The members' razor-sharp choreography radiates commanding presence from start to finish. Moments of elevated performance prowess, even stronger than in 'BAD', unfold one after another.
Since debut, ATEEZ has steadily claimed their place among performance leaders. 'Drip' extends that trajectory while revealing a more mature musical identity. As a pre-release, it amplifies curiosity about what the full mini album 15 will bring. Are you satisfied with ATEEZ's latest evolution?

 FAQ
 What kind of song is ATEEZ's 'Drip'? 
 ATEEZ's 'Drip' is the pre-release single from their 15th mini album, revealing the group's boldness and fearless swagger over heavy, powerful trap rhythms. It features catchy, addictive lines and a confident beat, showcasing their solid musical identity.
 When was the ATEEZ 'Drip' music video released? 
 ATEEZ pre-released the 'Drip' music video ahead of their 15th mini album. While no specific release date is provided, it's the music video for a pre-release single that came out before the full mini album.
 What are the characteristics of the ATEEZ 'Drip' music video? 
 The 'Drip' music video creates tension through dark lighting and dynamic camera movements, while the members' razor-sharp choreography radiates overwhelming presence. It visually embodies the group's heightened performance dominance since 'BAD'.
